blurb: Guests participate in sailing charters and lessons on Lake Ontario using various yachts. The company offers shared sails, private charters, and certified sailing lessons. Catering and beverage options are available for charters.
extraNote: All bookings final once confirmed; changes before 7 days may incur $20 fee per person · Cancellation Protection available for full refund up to 72 hours before sail · Captain may cancel or delay sail for safety; rainchecks issued if cancelled for weather · No refunds if guest chooses not to sail when conditions are safe · Late arrival or wrong marina results in forfeiture with no refund · No smoking, vaping, or recreational drugs allowed on vessels · Multiple waterfront locations in Toronto as specified in confirmation email.
